agents.summary: Low-latency office work and continuous conversation with native goal execution

install.blurb: Lightweight and fast, with native skill support (Agent Skills — the same standard as Claude Code).
install.warn: The 'pi' package on npm is a pi-day toy and @oh-my-pi is a third-party fork — use the exact full package name above.
install.config_how: Nekowork writes ~/.pi/agent/models.json for it (the only file it reads). Keys are stored as variable names only, never in plaintext.

agents.summary: Deep engineering and complete delivery with continuous execution on enterprise models

install.blurb: Apache-2.0 open-source Codex agent harness; connects over ACP and uses enterprise models assigned by Nekowork.
install.warn: Codex Harness speaks the OpenAI Responses protocol; the selected enterprise model gateway must provide a /responses endpoint.
install.config_how: Nekowork injects the model, gateway and short-lived credentials into an isolated process on every dispatch — nothing in plaintext on disk, and your personal Codex account is never read.

agents.summary: Open engineering agent that executes code and commands on enterprise models

install.blurb: Open-source coding agent; installs on demand and runs code and commands with enterprise models.
install.config_how: No setup needed. Nekowork injects the model configuration into its environment at dispatch time and writes no files — anything written to a file would be transparently encrypted by this machine and become unreadable to it.

agents.summary: Uses the local Codex account, keeping native planning and execution

install.blurb: Official OpenAI CLI. Uses its own account (ChatGPT login or OpenAI key) and ignores Nekowork's model configuration.
install.warn: This is the personal-account edition. To use enterprise models, install Codex Harness next to it; the enterprise gateway must support the OpenAI Responses protocol.
install.config_how: It manages its own login. If not signed in yet, run codex login once on the execution machine (or set OPENAI_API_KEY). Personal login stays fully isolated from the enterprise Codex Harness.

agents.summary: Nous Research agent with skills, browser tools and schedulers; runs on its own provider config

install.blurb: Hermes Agent (Nous Research); connects over ACP using its own providers, skills and memory.
install.warn: Hermes manages its own model providers and account; the Nekowork model catalog does not apply to it.
install.config_how: No setup. Nekowork launches `hermes acp` on the runner host; sign in once by running `hermes setup` there. --accept-hooks auto-approves first-run shell hooks so headless runs never stall on a prompt.

install.blurb: Apache-2.0 open-source coding agent; connects over ACP and supports OpenAI-compatible models.
install.config_how: Nekowork injects model configuration and keys via environment variables at dispatch time — nothing in plaintext on disk.
